# Lazur, llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org/

> Lazur is a macOS dictation and ambient writing app. Hold a hotkey, speak,
> and get text pasted into Slack, email, Cursor, Notion, and any Mac app.
> Live single-speaker dictation at the cursor, not meeting transcription.
> On-device NVIDIA Parakeet speech-to-text; optional cloud polish of text only.

## Product
- Name: Lazur
- Category: Context-aware voice workflow / ambient writing for macOS
- Tagline: Work by voice. Not by prompts.
- Website: https://www.lazur.app
- Download: https://www.lazur.app/download
- Pricing: https://www.lazur.app/pricing

## Key differentiators
- Live dictation at the cursor in any Mac app (not file or meeting transcription)
- Polished mode: reshapes speech into app-appropriate finished writing
- Transcript mode: local speech-to-text only
- Local-first STT: NVIDIA Parakeet on-device; only text sent for polish when enabled
- Command Mode: voice commands using the front window and selected text
- Personal dictionary and snippets
- No speaker identification

## Pricing (August 2026)
- Free: 5,000 words/month
- Pro: $14/month or $108/year, unlimited words, 50 Command Mode uses/month, 7-day free trial
- Power: $35/month or $270/year, unlimited Command Mode, priority support

## Best for
- Software engineers using Cursor, VS Code, or Xcode
- Knowledge workers writing Slack messages, emails, and docs
- Creators and operators producing high-volume written content
- Privacy-conscious Mac users who want local speech-to-text
